Pricing

# No calculator needed.    One price for everyone.
No tiers. No contracts. No features locked behind upgrades. Just one price that includes everything.

per user

per month

[Try it risk-free for 30 days](https://account.lessannoyingcrm.com/signup)

No credit card required · Cancel anytime

Includes everything:

✓Unlimited contacts and companies

✓25GB file storage per user

✓Unlimited pipelines

✓Task management

✓Email logging

✓Mobile access

✓User permissions

✓All features & free upgrades

✓Unlimited custom fields

✓HIPAA-compliance included

✓Free support, always

FAQ

## Common questions, straight answers.
What’s included in the free trial? +

With the free trial, you can use the software for 30 days for free — no questions asked, no hassles, no limitations. No credit card required to start.

Are there any contact storage limits? +

We don’t place any strict limits on the number of contacts and companies you can enter, but a good rule of thumb is to stay below 50,000 total.

How does account ownership work? +

Your data is yours, always. You can export everything at any time and we will never hold your data hostage.

What kind of training and support do you offer? +

Free email and phone support for everyone — even if you’re not a paying customer yet. Our coaches are real people who’ve been with us for years and know the product inside out.

How do I access LACRM? +

Less Annoying CRM is cloud-based — access it from any device with an internet connection. No downloads, no installs, no IT department required.

How secure is my data? +

Less Annoying CRM is hosted on Amazon Web Services in their North Virginia datacenter. All connections are encrypted, the live database is encrypted, and all backups are encrypted. If you work in the healthcare space, LACRM is HIPAA-compliant and you can sign a BAA with us.

## Prefer to talk to a real person first?
Book a quick call with our team. No pressure, no sales script — just an honest conversation about whether LACRM is the right fit for you.

# Less Annoying CRM Review 2026
- have little to no experience with CRM software,
- need just the basic small business CRM features,
- appreciate a single plan pricing structure,
- prefer working with real people over chatbots for support.

## Overview of Less Annoying CRM for Small Business
Popularly called LACRM, [Less Annoying CRM](https://www.onepagecrm.com/crm-alternatives/less-annoying/) was designed for small businesses and solopreneurs who want a simple interface and only the basic [CRM features](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/crm-features/)—and are willing to pay for just that.

It shows your most urgent business and personal to-dos, arranging tasks by due dates. There’s also a sidebar mini-calendar showing your daily events with exact times.

![less annoying crm homepage](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-homepage.D48iHVOl_1n93BD.webp)![less annoying crm homepage](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-homepage.D48iHVOl_1n93BD.webp)_Source: [Less Annoying CRM website](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/press)_

On Less Annoying CRM, you can add an unlimited number of contacts and manage all their information from a single page. It also offers unlimited pipelines, as well as lead management and task tracking functionalities.

And unlike many of its counterparts, the CRM software has only one pricing plan with no hidden costs, gated features, or add-ons.

However, this simplicity comes with trade-offs. Less Annoying CRM lacks more advanced features that may be useful for growing businesses, such as workflow automation or omnichannel communications.

The CRM system also doesn’t offer full email sync. You can keep a record of emails, but you cannot send them directly from inside the CRM.

For businesses that need just the basics and want to avoid complexity, this might be exactly what you’re looking for. But if you’re planning to scale or need more sophisticated features, you might find it limiting.

## Less Annoying CRM Pros and Cons
- Intuitive interface with a minimalist design
- Minimal features, so there’s almost no learning curve
- Single pricing plan with no hidden costs
- Unlimited contacts and pipelines included
- Human support from experienced coaches
- 30-day free trial available
- Daily email reminders of tasks for the day

Cons

## Key CRM Features of Less Annoying CRM
Less Annoying CRM focuses on delivering core CRM functionality without the complexity.

This breakdown will help you see exactly what Less Annoying CRM offers for $15 a month.

## Less Annoying CRM Pricing Structure
Less Annoying CRM may have one of the simplest pricing structures amongst all CRM for small business.

There’s just one pricing plan, and that’s all you’ll ever have to pay for. There are no gated features, hidden costs, or upgrades/add-ons to purchase.

### How Much Does Less Annoying CRM Cost?
Less Annoying CRM costs $15 per user/month + tax.

![less annoying crm pricing plan](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-pricing.BhONn5Tl_Zb5tza.webp)

Although there’s no free plan, they do have a 30-day free trial. You can also opt for their live demo to test out the tool and see if it’s the right fit for you before signing up.

### Is Less Annoying CRM an Affordable CRM for Small Business?
At $15 per user/month, Less Annoying CRM sits right in the middle of the ideal $10-20 per user/month range for small businesses.

The pricing is transparent, so you know exactly what you’re paying for, with no surprise costs or pressure to upgrade for essential features. And unlike other CRMs that start cheap but quickly become expensive when you need more features, LACRM gives you everything it has for one price.

However, the lack of features like automation, 2-way email sync, and telephony means you might need to pay for additional third-party tools to fill the gaps. This takes away from LACRM being an [affordable CRM](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/best-affordable-crms/) for small business.

Moreover, since there’s no upper plan with more robust features for growing businesses, you may have to switch to another CRM entirely when your needs become more complex.

## Best Alternative for Less Annoying CRM
Check out [OnePageCRM](https://www.onepagecrm.com/).

**Value:** High

**Impact:** High

**Speed:** High

**Pricing starts from**: $9.95

Unlike Less Annoying CRM’s basic approach, OnePageCRM offers a comprehensive feature set while maintaining simplicity. It includes full email sync, workflow automation, click-to-call on desktop, and follow-up tracking—all starting at a lower price point.

# Less Annoying CRM Review 2026

Is Less Annoying CRM the right fit for your small business? We tested the software and compiled this CRM review to answer that question.

![](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/sam-headshot.wsfmr8nW_2dLVf7.webp)

Samuel Oyebode [Samuel Oyebode on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/samuel-oyebode-b62419213)Last tested July 8, 2026

So, you’re looking for a [small business CRM](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/best-crm-for-small-business/) (customer relationship management) tool, and Less Annoying CRM keeps showing up on your radar.

Built specifically for small teams, this [CRM system](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/what-is-crm/) takes a different approach from most competitors. Instead of packing in features and complex pricing tiers, it focuses on simplicity and offers only one pricing plan.

But is this enough to make Less Annoying CRM the right choice for your small business?

We thoroughly tested Less Annoying to see how it performs as a CRM for small business.

[![](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/8J866_R0svQ/maxresdefault.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8J866_R0svQ)

Less Annoying CRM is recommended for small businesses that:

- have little to no experience with CRM software,
- need just the basic small business CRM features,
- appreciate a single plan pricing structure,
- prefer working with real people over chatbots for support.

Less Annoying CRM is not recommended for small businesses that:

- need workflow automation capabilities,
- rely on email communication,
- need built-in telephony.

## Overview of Less Annoying CRM for Small Business

Popularly called LACRM, [Less Annoying CRM](https://www.onepagecrm.com/crm-alternatives/less-annoying/) was designed for small businesses and solopreneurs who want a simple interface and only the basic [CRM features](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/crm-features/)—and are willing to pay for just that.

When you log in, you’re greeted with a workspace that summarizes your database and provides a quick overview of your pipeline. It shows your most urgent business and personal to-dos, arranging tasks by due dates. There’s also a sidebar mini-calendar showing your daily events with exact times.

![less annoying crm homepage](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-homepage.D48iHVOl_1n93BD.webp)![less annoying crm homepage](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-homepage.D48iHVOl_1n93BD.webp)_Source: [Less Annoying CRM website](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/press)_

On Less Annoying CRM, you can add an unlimited number of contacts and manage all their information from a single page. It also offers unlimited pipelines, as well as lead management and task tracking functionalities.

And unlike many of its counterparts, the CRM software has only one pricing plan with no hidden costs, gated features, or add-ons.

However, this simplicity comes with trade-offs. Less Annoying CRM lacks more advanced features that may be useful for growing businesses, such as workflow automation or omnichannel communications.

The CRM system also doesn’t offer full email sync. You can keep a record of emails, but you cannot send them directly from inside the CRM.

For businesses that need just the basics and want to avoid complexity, this might be exactly what you’re looking for. But if you’re planning to scale or need more sophisticated features, you might find it limiting.

## Less Annoying CRM Pros and Cons

Like any CRM for small business, Less Annoying CRM has its strengths and limitations.

Pros

- Intuitive interface with a minimalist design
- Minimal features, so there’s almost no learning curve
- Single pricing plan with no hidden costs
- Unlimited contacts and pipelines included
- Human support from experienced coaches
- 30-day free trial available
- Daily email reminders of tasks for the day

Cons

- The pipeline page is hard to access
- No workflow automation available
- You can’t send emails from inside the CRM
- No full two-way email sync
- No click-to-call on desktop (mobile app only)
- You can’t ‘@’ your team members in notes
- No browser extension for auto lead capture
- No email sequences or campaigns
- Dashboard is too basic

## Key CRM Features of Less Annoying CRM

Less Annoying CRM focuses on delivering core CRM functionality without the complexity.

To help you determine whether it’s a good fit for your small business, we’ve compiled a table overview of the key features you might be looking for.

This breakdown will help you see exactly what Less Annoying CRM offers for $15 a month.

| Core Features |
| Mobile app | YesiOS & Android |
| Contact management | Yes |
| Follow-up tracking | No |
| Pipelines | YesUnlimited |
| Duplicate management | Yes |
| Centralization Tools |
| Centralized workspaceiDefinition: A centralized workspace is an essential small business CRM feature that lets you manage your whole business on just one page. | PartlyOverviews of CRM only |
| Dashboard | PartlyBasic |
| Number of integrations | 29+ |
| Communication Tools |
| Two-way email sync | NoOnly email history |
| Click-to-call options | PartlyMobile app only |
| Multi-channel inbox | No |
| Meeting scheduling | No |
| Simple Automation |
| CRM workflows | No |
| Sales email sequences | No |
| Free web forms | Yes |
| Browser extension for auto lead capture | No |
| Customer Support |
| Email support | Yes |
| Live chat | No |
| Phone support | Yes |
| Pricing |
| Starting price | $15 per seat/month + tax |

| Free plan | No |
| Next paid plan | NoNone |

What Less Annoying CRM includes, by feature group. The first column names the feature; the second is what Less Annoying CRM gives you.

Let’s take a closer look at this CRM system’s key features.

### Contact Management

Add an unlimited number of contacts to Less Annoying CRM, and organize them in a list in the Contact tab.

Click on a contact to manage their personal and company info, add tasks to them, schedule events, share documents, attach sales opportunities (leads), and keep a record of all interactions and email correspondence—all on one page.

![less annoying crm contact page](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-contact-page.N3hew1-4_Z2dpLOo.webp)![less annoying crm contact page](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-contact-page.N3hew1-4_Z2dpLOo.webp)

### Task Management

With just a few clicks, you can create tasks or events, assign them to a member of your team, and set their due dates.

You can view and manage these activities via:

- **LACRM’s Calendar tab**
- **Your Google Calendar** (if synced to your CRM)
- **Your workspace**
- **Daily email reminders**

![less annoying crm calendar](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-calendar.BZ1-gLxG_27Cr7b.webp)![less annoying crm calendar](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-calendar.BZ1-gLxG_27Cr7b.webp)

That being said, Less Annoying CRM doesn’t have a [follow-up tracking](https://www.onepagecrm.com/features/take-action/) functionality, which is one of the criteria we use for grading all small business CRMs.

### Pipeline Management

In Less Annoying CRM, you can create as many pipelines as you want. Add leads to a pipeline, and they’ll be organized on one page, with their stages visible.

![less annoying crm pipeline](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-alt-pipeline.CqiAU7zR_1BhuVL.webp)![less annoying crm pipeline](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-alt-pipeline.CqiAU7zR_1BhuVL.webp)

The pipeline page uses a Kanban layout. You can drag and drop leads from one stage to the next, or manage their details right from the board.

However, the page for pipelines is not the easiest or quickest to open. It’s buried in the ‘reports’ tab, instead of being boldly displayed amongst the tabs in the CRM system’s main menu.

![buried pipeline in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-buried-pipeline.C7Hr8hg5_2be3Qk.webp)![buried pipeline in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-buried-pipeline.C7Hr8hg5_2be3Qk.webp)

### Lead Management

In Less Annoying CRM, you can add new leads from the ‘Add new records’ module on the navigation menu or via a contact or company page.

Clicking on a lead opens up the side panel for lead management. You can add tasks, create notes, change the associated contact, or update the lead status. You can also delete the lead or view a history of all your interactions with it.

![less annoying crm lead page](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-lead-management.6XEZw7qg_ZYqJWC.webp)![less annoying crm lead page](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-lead-management.6XEZw7qg_ZYqJWC.webp)

### Email Sync

LACRM does not have 2-way email sync. It only partially connects with your email provider. While you cannot send emails directly from the CRM, you can log emails to and from contacts inside it.

![email log in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-email-sync.BP701vRO_Z2l3QgN.webp)![email log in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-email-sync.BP701vRO_Z2l3QgN.webp)

Less Annoying CRM offers both manual and automatic [email logging](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/help/log-email-communication-with-a-contact-or-a-company).

For the former, you’ll have to BCC or forward emails to a unique address provided by LACRM. For the latter, after connecting to your email provider’s server, emails to and from your CRM contacts will be automatically logged.

![less annoying crm email bcc](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-bcc-email.CMfwACvZ_Z1LLT0A.webp)![less annoying crm email bcc](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-bcc-email.CMfwACvZ_Z1LLT0A.webp)

### Collaboration

LACRM allows you to add your team members to the tool and collaborate through shared pipelines, contacts, and notes. You can also delegate contacts, tasks, and events to specific team members.

Moreover, to keep collaborations organized and secure, this small business CRM features user permissions, so you can control which members of your team can access certain pieces of CRM data.

However, the collaboration feature has one pitfall. You [can’t ‘@’ other users](https://www.g2.com/products/less-annoying-crm/reviews?utf8=%E2%9C%93&order=g2_default&filters%5Bsentiment_snippet%5D=1414352#:~:text=%2D-,There%20was%20one,-(minor)%20feature%20that) when you’re attaching a note to a contact.

### Duplicate Management

This CRM software lets you find duplicate contacts via matching phone numbers and or email addresses. Once identified, you can [merge](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/help/how-to-merge-contact-or-company) their contact data and history into one record.

![less annoying crm duplicate detection](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-duplicate-management.DQZagha__1p0yjT.webp)![less annoying crm duplicate detection](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-duplicate-management.DQZagha__1p0yjT.webp)

If you’re merging two duplicate contacts with conflicting information (say, the names are different), you’ll be prompted to select which info to keep.

![merge contact in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-merge-duplicate.C0XVCJls_Z11Y2K5.webp)![merge contact in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-merge-duplicate.C0XVCJls_Z11Y2K5.webp)

### Centralized Workspace

The Workspace tab contains a quick overview of your pipeline and shows all activities carried out on the CRM. It also shows your most urgent (overdue and for the day) business and personal to-dos, and arranges the tasks according to their due dates.

There’s also a sidebar — a mini calendar of sorts — that displays your events for the day, and the exact time they take place.

![central workspace in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-workspace.BaifgdnE_wQu4h.webp)![central workspace in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-workspace.BaifgdnE_wQu4h.webp)

### Dashboard and Reporting

The dashboard and reporting features are on the “Reports” tab in the main navigation menu.

Less Annoying CRM allows you to create reports based on your pipelines, tasks, and CRM activities. You can customize the reports using various sorting and filtering options available on the tool.

However, you [can’t save reports](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/help/save-a-report) inside the CRM. You can bookmark a filtered report in your browser, or download it as a PDF or export it as a spreadsheet.

The dashboards LACRM provides are very basic. It only shows the total number of leads in the “Prospect” and “Qualified Lead” stages.

![less annoying crm dashboard](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-dashboard.DN4NH-R0_17w8Ut.webp)![less annoying crm dashboard](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-dashboard.DN4NH-R0_17w8Ut.webp)

While LACRM might be aiming for simplicity, its dashboards are still below par, even for a simple one.

### Automations

There are no native workflow automations available on Less Annoying CRM. The small business CRM also has no functionality for sending out email sequences. Likewise, it doesn’t feature any browser extensions for capturing leads automatically.

That being said, LACRM does have a form builder tool. Head to Settings → Feature settings → Form builder and create a form. If a contact fills it out, their info will be automatically added to your CRM.

![less annoying crm form builder](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-automations.BDIdGvoi_Zy0bN8.webp)![less annoying crm form builder](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-automations.BDIdGvoi_Zy0bN8.webp)

### Integrations

Less Annoying CRM offers very limited integration options. There are only 29+ business apps on the marketplace for you to integrate with.

The silver lining is that Zapier is one of those tools, and by integrating with it, you can connect 5,000 other business apps to Less Annoying CRM.

![integrations in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-integrations.BbZo_r4z_1sRDTB.webp)![integrations in less annoying crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-integrations.BbZo_r4z_1sRDTB.webp)

### Mobile App

Less Annoying CRM launched a native mobile app (iOS and Android) in early 2026. You can add contacts, leads, tasks, and events, view your pipeline, and call, text, or email contacts directly from the app.

That said, for some reason, LACRM itself calls it a ‘work in progress’.

![less annoying crm mobile interface](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-mobile.D-NVZidx_1kluKS.webp)![less annoying crm mobile interface](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-mobile.D-NVZidx_1kluKS.webp)

## Ease of Use

Less Annoying CRM’s creators built this tool for users who have little to no experience with CRM platforms, and those who don’t need many features.

That’s why the software features a minimalist design with a color scheme that’s easy on the eyes, and a visible text layout that makes it easier for you to see what you’re working with.

It’s also why it has only 4 main tabs in the menu, all of which are neatly organized on the left side of the screen. And when you hover over any of them, you get a quick overview of what’s in it without opening it.

By housing only the basic features a small business needs, LACRM reduces the learning curve as much as possible.

This may be why it has a [4.9/5 rating on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/less-annoying-crm/reviews) from 660+ reviews, most of which are from users who mention how easy the software is to learn, set up, and use.

## Customer Support

Less Annoying CRM boasts a [world-class customer support](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/help/training-and-support) that doesn’t include any chatbots or AI call centers.

When you need help, you’ll be attended to by a real person. More specifically, a coach who knows the product inside out. They offer support to you via emails, phone calls, and contact forms.

Phone support is only available from 9:00 am to 4:30 pm (CST) on weekdays. If you need help on weekends, email support is the only option.

Nevertheless, LACRM’s human-centered approach to support means you’ll get personalized help from people who truly understand the product.

## Less Annoying CRM Pricing Structure

Less Annoying CRM may have one of the simplest pricing structures amongst all CRM for small business.

There’s just one pricing plan, and that’s all you’ll ever have to pay for. There are no gated features, hidden costs, or upgrades/add-ons to purchase.

### How Much Does Less Annoying CRM Cost?

Less Annoying CRM costs $15 per user/month + tax.

![less annoying crm pricing plan](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/less-annoying-crm-pricing.BhONn5Tl_Zb5tza.webp)

Although there’s no free plan, they do have a 30-day free trial. You can also opt for their live demo to test out the tool and see if it’s the right fit for you before signing up.

### Is Less Annoying CRM an Affordable CRM for Small Business?

At $15 per user/month, Less Annoying CRM sits right in the middle of the ideal $10-20 per user/month range for small businesses.

The pricing is transparent, so you know exactly what you’re paying for, with no surprise costs or pressure to upgrade for essential features. And unlike other CRMs that start cheap but quickly become expensive when you need more features, LACRM gives you everything it has for one price.

However, the lack of features like automation, 2-way email sync, and telephony means you might need to pay for additional third-party tools to fill the gaps. This takes away from LACRM being an [affordable CRM](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/best-affordable-crms/) for small business.

Moreover, since there’s no upper plan with more robust features for growing businesses, you may have to switch to another CRM entirely when your needs become more complex.

## Final Verdict: Is Less Annoying CRM the Best CRM for Small Business?

Less Annoying CRM delivers exactly what it promises: a less annoying CRM experience through basic features, excellent customer support, and transparent pricing.

However, Less Annoying CRM falls short for businesses that need more than the basics. The lack of automation, inability to send emails directly from the CRM, limited integrations, and the absence of click-to-call on the desktop app, could become significant roadblocks as your business grows.

The pipeline management being buried in the reports tab also suggests this small business CRM isn’t ideal for heavily sales-focused teams who live in their pipeline view.

According to our criteria (Value, Impact, and Speed), **Less Annoying CRM’s** fit for small businesses is **Moderate**.
